name: Black Book
author: shadowevor
description: Vortex extension for Black Book (Steam App 1138660, Windows). Adds game detection and a mod type for file-replacement mods: Traditional Chinese localization config files (Black Book_Data/StreamingAssets/Config/**), BepInEx plugins (BepInEx/plugins/), and the BepInEx 5 framework (winhttp.dll + BepInEx/), all deployed to the game root. Handles game-root-relative and single-wrapper-folder archives. Overwritten game files are backed up and restored automatically by Vortex on purge.
